name: @sentropic/cli
description: The Sentropic umbrella CLI: binary `stp` (alias `sentropic`) that federates the ecosystem as subcommands (`stp app …`, and reserved federation points `stp graphify …` / `stp h2a …` / `stp remote …`). BR-42a1 ships the subcommand-registration seam; `stp app` is delivered by @sentropic/build-cli.
